args.text:
Batch: 15 runs. 6 were accepted (r02, r04, r06, r07, r10, r12), 4 were declined and 5 were not reported.
Flagged: 2. r06 and r07 are flagged because a check failed but the runs were still accepted. Closure failed on both: r06 scored 2.928 and r07 scored 2.915, against a threshold of 1.0 px/h. This means the tip motion from the midline and stage log does not match the tip motion from the tracked kinematics.
Cleared: 4. r02, r04, r10 and r12 pass rigid-body invariance and closure, with no roll-backs. Their strain-rate profiles match the batch: the REGR peak is about 42–42.5 %/h at 316 µm, the growth zone is 526–537 µm long and every |z| is 1.43 or less. They used the width-free ratio, so the plane-sections check was not run, as expected.
What the flagged runs have in common: both kept a single remedy (the width-free ratio) over 6 steps. Their summaries look like the batch (REGR peak 42.0–42.4 %/h at 316 µm, all |z| ≤ 1.01), so only the failed closure check shows the problem. Their velocity and strain-rate fields should not be reported until the closure mismatch is fixed.
